05 / METHOD

Workflow and interpretation

Summary of the analysis approach represented by the supplied materials.

STEP 01

Define Nagpur ULB

Use the urban local body boundary to define the area for the raster analysis and visual comparison.

STEP 02

Compare GHSL epochs

Use building-volume layers for 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015 and 2020 to examine the temporal pattern.

STEP 03

Map change and hotspots

Compare the supplied change map and top-10%-gain zones alongside the city-level time series.

Data-quality and consistency note. The supplied map labels show 426.7 million m³ for 2000 and 507.4 million m³ for 2020, while the supplied CSV results show 437.147 and 521.977 million m³. These outputs are not numerically consistent. Before using the result in a report, check that the maps and table were generated from the same raster version, mask, boundary, units, grid alignment and aggregation method. The figures are presented here as supplied, without assuming which output is correct.
